name: liendeadline
description: US mechanics lien and preliminary notice deadlines for construction material suppliers.
long_description: Calculates material supplier notice and lien outcomes from delivery facts using LienDeadline's API. Start with v3 discovery for current jurisdiction-specific scope support and exact rule identities; the separate v2 baseline covers Florida and Kansas private projects. Supplier discovery and calculations require a dedicated customer key. Discovery uses no calculation allowance; completed calculations consume plan allowance. Editorial lien guides for all 50 states and DC are public without a key. Unresolved facts and unsupported scopes need qualified review. Not legal advice.
